user.title: Set up solar dashboard
user.description: Connect your solar dashboard. No invitation is needed when automatic registration is enabled. An account is created only after your consent.

live.title: Select live sensors
live.description: Only total solar power is required. Without balcony solar, select your PV power sensor there and leave both separate fields empty. With balcony solar, the total sensor must already include PV + balcony solar; separate values are not added automatically. Select the optional separate sensors for the fullscreen breakdown. The small widget shows total power.

data_description.power_w: Without balcony solar: PV power. With balcony solar: combined PV + balcony solar sensor.
data_description.pv_dc_w: Optional separate PV reading; may be left empty.
data_description.bkw_w: Select only if balcony solar exists; otherwise leave empty.

energy.title: Select cumulative energy counters
energy.description: Configure the selected solar dashboard settings.

consent.title: Confirm data transfer
consent.description: Send the selected power, battery and energy readings to the relay over HTTPS. Live and daily values are sent every minute; month and year values every six hours. No HA access token or entity names are uploaded.

data.consent: I consent to transmitting my selected readings.

server.title: Custom server
server.description: Change only if you operate your own service.

invite.title: Enter invitation
invite.description: This server still requires an invitation from its operator.

error.invalid_url: Enter an HTTPS relay origin without a path or credentials.

error.duplicate_energy: Do not select the same energy counter twice.

error.registration_rate_limited: Too many new accounts from this internet connection. Please try again later.
error.registration_full: The service cannot accept more installations right now. Existing accounts remain available.
error.registration_revoked: This previous setup was deleted. Confirm again to create a new account.
error.registration_not_ready: Automatic registration is not available yet. Please try again later.
error.registration_invalid: Registration could not be processed. Please reopen setup.
error.registration_ip_unavailable: The service could not verify the connection. Please try again later.
error.registration_unavailable: Registration is currently unavailable. Retry safely without creating a second account.
